name: ember
description: Ember frontend workspace: the Next.js app (web/), the shared packages (packages/*) and later the Electron app (desktop/).

scripts.format: prettier --write web packages package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.base.json eslint.config.mjs eslint.architecture.mjs eslint.architecture.d.mts .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check web packages package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.base.json eslint.config.mjs eslint.architecture.mjs eslint.architecture.d.mts .prettierrc.json
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
